metrics.note: Clear multi-step approach that builds speed from frame 34 through the plant near frames 47-49, with a low penultimate and directional steps. Both arms drawing back behind the hips at the plant is not readable at this camera distance, so it is left unjudged rather than penalized.

Fix the arm load and contact point and this becomes a genuinely aggressive swing on the same footwork.
